description: This file defines a function to ensure the database schema for memory indexing, including creation of tables, indexes, and virtual tables with optional full-text search support. It manages schema setup for files, chunks, and cache tables, and handles errors related to FTS table creation.

methods.name: ensureMemoryIndexSchema
methods.description: Sets up database tables, indexes, and virtual tables for memory indexing, with optional full-text search support, and handles schema modifications.

methods.name: ensureColumn
methods.description: Checks if a column exists in a table and adds it if missing.
